t.zh: 相机自带的降噪比你的干净，厂家却没说它怎么给邻居分配分量。给它喂几张自己画的图，看它吐出什么。
t.en: The camera’s built-in denoising is cleaner than yours, and the maker never said how it weighs the neighbours. Feed it pictures you draw and watch what comes out.

after.zh: 一个亮点进去，出来的就是它给每个邻居的分量，叫<wiki-ref to="impulse-response"></wiki-ref>。这台降噪中间最重，越往外越轻。
after.en: One bright dot in, and out comes the share it gives each neighbour: its <wiki-ref to="impulse-response"></wiki-ref>. This denoiser weighs the centre most and less further out.

brief.zh: 画一张能分清三种说法的图，运行，再选输出支持的那一种。
brief.en: Draw a picture that tells the three accounts apart, run it, then pick the one the output supports.

hint.zh: 一整片同样亮的图，三种降噪都不会改变它。
hint.en: A picture of one brightness all over is left unchanged by all three.

hint.zh: 想看清它对每个邻居做了什么，就让只有一格是亮的。
hint.en: To see what it does with each neighbour, light just one cell.

title.zh: 它怎么给邻居分配分量？
title.en: How does it share among the neighbours?
